chapters.title: The Website
cues: Welcome to NOIR BARBER CLUB.
A premium digital home for a modern barbershop.
Visitors meet the barbers, explore every service and price,
browse the gallery, memberships and gift cards,
and find the way to the shop.
In three languages, on desktop and mobile.

chapters.title: The Owner
cues: Behind it runs a private management system.
The owner signs in through the staff entrance,
and sees today's revenue, bookings and chair utilisation at a glance.
Every appointment sits on a live day board.
The owner manages customers, creates barber accounts and sets working hours,
updates services and prices,
reviews revenue, gift cards and memberships.
One central workspace.

chapters.title: The Barber
cues: Each barber signs in to a personal workspace,
not the owner's dashboard.
The day opens with the next client: name, service, time and notes.
One tap marks them arrived, starts the service, and completes it.
Calendar and schedule show only their own appointments.

chapters.title: The Customer
cues: For customers, it starts on their phone.
They create an account with their name, email, phone number and password.
A six-digit code is sent to their email.
They enter it, and the account is verified.
Then they sign in with their email and password.
To book, they choose a barber,
then a service and its price,
pick a date and an available time,
review, and confirm.
The booking gets its own reference.
In My appointments, they see their visits, open the details,
and can cancel online up to a day before.
NOIR BARBER CLUB.
One platform. Three experiences.
A smarter way to manage, work, and book.
